content: Chrome 66+, Safari 11+, and Firefox 66+ all start every new AudioContext in a 'suspended' state until a user gesture occurs. The fix is to call audioCtx.resume() inside a gesture-triggered event handler (click/touchstart/touchend/keydown) — commonly done once, on the first such event after page load, then never again for the session. Without this the AudioContext stays suspended and no Web Audio sound will play, silently.
